additional_info.subject: case Upadte
additional_info.body:
I noticed that the old CCV terminal was constantly restarting. I replaced it with a new one and activated it from my side. There are no more errors in the log.
However, I still see an error (see attached picture) when selecting 'Credit Card' on the screen. I called Cloe from Sparki, and she will follow up with the company responsible for the CCV terminal.
